notes.title: New update available! V0.9
notes.notes:
Hello!

We continue working on the development of Sea of ​​Brave Beast Island, but we also move forward on a major update for Aidan Adventure, always looking for a better gaming experience. For this update we visually improved the interface of different sections, such as:
[list]
[*] Home
[*] Save Screen
[*] Stage Results
[*] Game Over
[*] Options
[*] Figon Island Map Section (we completely revamped its design to an old map style)
[*] Poster Section of the first location (Unlocked as we collect Aidan's letters in each stage).
[/list]
We also made the following adjustments and improvements:
[list]
[*] We corrected the sound in the Giant Crab chase stage specifically in the crab waiting sections.
[*] We improved the operation of the Horned Spider enemy in Challenge 1, in Green Forest.
[*] We reviewed and adjusted the options menu, the resolutions, so that it can be adjusted correctly the first time you start on Steam Deck.
[/list]

notes.title: Jump Platform Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

The jumping platform is updated, the operation is corrected, the jumping platform works without having to press the jump button, but in some cases when pressing it it delivered a jump greater than the one defined, so it is updated to correct that error.

Thank you.

notes.title: Game Update V0.8 (12/28/2023) - Happy new year's eve holidays!
notes.notes:
Hello!, 

New update available, we make the following improvements and corrections:

[list]
[*] Adjusted the contact collision with skeletons.
[*] Updated the sound of the Giant Crab in stage 06 of the first section, changing it from drums to sounds of heavy footsteps.
[*] Adjusted the crab contact collision.
[*] The activation of the fire and water bar has been updated, the fire bar will be visible once the special fire abilities are activated, and for the water bar, it will only be visible with water contact.
[*] Added a smoke effect to the village fire.
[*] Jump adjustment on the edges.
[/list]

Also, we are participating in the Steam winter sales until January 4, 2024, so you can find the game with a special discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677143/bb6ab3974c6aecd30900a6ea65d16fb5c1b19504.png[/img]

Thank you very much for supporting the game, and Happy new year's eve holidays! :)

notes.title: Sea of Brave: Aidan Adventure Available!
notes.notes:
Hi!,

We are pleased to announce that Sea of Brave Aidan Adventure is now available on Steam, it has been an incredible journey, with its difficulties, but enormously rewarding.

When I started this crazy adventure, I didn't imagine how difficult it would be, but at the same time how incredible it is to share a story, an adventure, from the process of writing, creating characters, drawing and finally giving it movement. We are very happy with the result and hope that everyone can enjoy Aidan's adventure and meet Captain Skull and his fearsome pirate crew.

Thanks for all the support :)

notes.title: Game updates (Gamepad)
notes.notes:
Hi, we have new news about the world of Sea of Brave, we thank all the people who supported us during the Next fest October 2023, downloading the demo and/or marking the wish list, thank you very much.

We are adding the Gamepad option in the options menu, so you can select the type of controller you want to use, to provide a better gaming experience.

The game will be released in Q4 2023.

Thank you for all your support :)
